contract.ablation: real vs shuffle-label floor; linear probe vs small-MLP probe per affordance contrast
contract.baseline: shuffle-label chance floor (the gate); frozen-random projection reported but known-vacuous
contract.null_hypothesis: action-relevance labels do not exceed the shuffle-label chance floor: the affordance contrast is not decodable from the pooled latent at all (taxonomy 3). Note: clearing this floor establishes decodability, NOT encoder-specificity. A frozen-random LINEAR projection is invertible so a linear probe re-learns through it (delta_vs_frozen_random ~ 0 by construction); it is reported for transparency but cannot license a substrate-specificity claim, which needs a random-init encoder comparison that lives in the caching path, not here.

contract.ablation: train probe on viewpoint A, test on held-out viewpoint B; real vs frozen-random
contract.baseline: pixel-difference baseline and a frozen-random-substrate arm
contract.null_hypothesis: event identity does not transfer across viewpoint conditions beyond a pixel-difference baseline, OR the real encoder invariance ties frozen-random (pooling plus random already smears viewpoint, so invariance is trivial averaging not structure)

contract.ablation: conjunctive KV retrieval vs intersect-independent-features vs recency-only
contract.baseline: independent-feature retrieve-then-intersect and a recency-only baseline
contract.null_hypothesis: integrated what-where-when retrieval does not beat independent single-feature retrieval intersected post hoc (no binding, just three lookups), OR the where and when tags are not decodable from the stored latent at all (taxonomy 3)

contract.ablation: successor representation over latents vs transition-frequency; real vs frozen-random
contract.baseline: transition-frequency baseline and a frozen-random-substrate arm
contract.null_hypothesis: latents support only observed-transition prediction; held-out shortcut reachability ties a transition-frequency baseline (no map, just a chain), OR position is not decodable above floor (taxonomy 3)

contract.ablation: action-conditioned vs action-blind vs action-shuffled at matched FLOPs
contract.baseline: action-blind next-latent predictor at matched compute and an action-shuffle control
contract.null_hypothesis: action-conditioning does not reduce next-latent error beyond the action-blind predictor at matched compute, OR the gain survives action-shuffling (so it was added capacity, taxonomy 9, not action information)

contract.ablation: temporal-window shell carrying state vs frame-only probe; real vs frozen-random
contract.baseline: single-frame-only probe and a frozen-random-substrate arm
contract.null_hypothesis: mid-occlusion the latent carries no decodable trace of the hidden object beyond the current (empty) frame, so permanence and vanish are indistinguishable until reappearance (taxonomy 3), OR a single-frame baseline already separates them

contract.ablation: learned VQ code vs random code across a codebook-size sweep; sender-receiver shuffle
contract.baseline: random-codebook of the same size and a raw-latent-passthrough ceiling
contract.null_hypothesis: the code transmits no more target information than a random code of the same size (no referential structure), OR target direction/distance is not decodable from the pooled latent at all (taxonomy 3), so there is nothing to encode

contract.ablation: affordance-times-LP selection vs LP-only vs prior-only vs uniform
contract.baseline: learning-progress-only, affordance-prior-only (LP off), uniform; plus noisy-TV guards
contract.null_hypothesis: affordance weighting ties pure learning-progress on coverage, OR it helps only because of the static prior (the prior-only arm matches it), OR it re-chases the noisy-TV (the affordance probe fires on noise); any of these is taxonomy 8 or 2

contract.ablation: activation-energy (L1) penalty swept vs dense vs a plain width sweep
contract.baseline: the dense shell and a matched width sweep tracing the same accuracy-FLOP line
contract.null_hypothesis: the energy penalty only moves accuracy and FLOPs along the same line a width sweep already traces (no special frontier), or sparsity collapses accuracy with no usable operating point

contract.ablation: clonal affinity eviction, with and without somatic mutation, vs PER vs random
contract.baseline: PER (priority) eviction and random eviction at the SAME buffer slots
contract.null_hypothesis: at matched slots clonal-selection eviction ties PER and random on backward transfer within the seed spread, and the somatic-mutation arm does not beat the no-mutation arm

contract.ablation: naive-from-meta-init vs naive-from-generic-init; meta-init trained WITH protection
contract.baseline: a naive learner (no replay, no EWC) from a GENERIC init on the same stream
contract.null_hypothesis: the meta-init confers no retention advantage to a naive learner over a generic init (nothing assimilated; protection lives only in the online mechanism)

contract.ablation: stigmergic pheromone field (deposit=LP, evaporation) vs explicit LP vs raw-error deposit
contract.baseline: explicit learning-progress (LP) selector over the same regions
contract.null_hypothesis: the stigmergic field ties explicit LP selection (it is a reparameterization of the same bandit), and a raw-error deposit chases the noisy-TV unless the deposit uses LP

contract.ablation: none, homeostasis-only, EWC-only, EWC+homeostasis; frozen-random substrate arm
contract.baseline: naive sequential (no protection) and EWC-only on the domain stream
contract.null_hypothesis: homeostatic scaling alone does not beat naive on backward transfer (a normalization trick, not protection), and it adds nothing on top of EWC (same protected directions)

contract.ablation: structurally-distinct sub-predictors (degenerate) vs single vs copies, at matched compute
contract.baseline: matched-param single predictor and K identical copies (pure redundancy)
contract.null_hypothesis: degeneracy ties the matched-param single predictor and ties pure redundancy on both perturbation robustness and retention (any win was capacity, removed by matched compute)

contract.ablation: online vs offline-interleaved vs offline+generative-dreaming, at matched replay budget
contract.baseline: online replay at a fixed total replay budget
contract.null_hypothesis: offline interleaving ties online replay at matched replay budget (scheduling does not matter, only sample count), and the dreaming arm fails to match stored replay

contract.ablation: ordered (easy-to-hard) vs shuffled vs hard-first (anti-curriculum); D3 resolvability check
contract.baseline: the same data presented in shuffled order at matched total samples
contract.null_hypothesis: ordered curriculum ties shuffled at matched samples (order does not matter on a frozen pooled substrate; the stream is too uniform or short for staging to bite)

contract.ablation: experience-driven growth (add units on plateau) vs fixed-final-capacity vs fixed-initial-capacity
contract.baseline: fixed-capacity shell whose width EQUALS the grown final width (matched-final-capacity)
contract.null_hypothesis: a shell that GROWS capacity in response to experience (adding hidden units when learning plateaus) does not beat a fixed shell of the SAME final capacity trained the same way; any gain is just the extra capacity, not the growth process

contract.ablation: flat vs +forward-model-error-as-feature vs +forward-model-with-stop-gradient
contract.baseline: a flat predictor at MATCHED compute (no forward-model correction loop)
contract.null_hypothesis: the forward-model head ties the flat predictor at matched compute (the correction loop is just extra depth), or rollout R2 is below the D6 floor so there is nothing to correct against

contract.ablation: real factorized latents vs frozen-random projection; held-out diagonal vs seen cells
contract.baseline: shuffle-label floor (chance) and a frozen-random projection arm on the same factor grid
contract.null_hypothesis: held-out-combination accuracy collapses to chance while seen-combination accuracy is high (pooled latent encodes whole-clip conjunctions, not separable factors), or both factors are jointly undecodable so the test is uninterpretable

contract.ablation: structure-mapped offset transfer vs shuffled-offset; real latents vs frozen-random
contract.baseline: shuffled-offset control (offset estimated from a mismatched content pair) and chance rank
contract.null_hypothesis: offset vectors do not transfer across object contents (the transform is entangled with identity), so analogy retrieval ties the shuffled-offset control, or the transform factor is not decodable at all

contract.ablation: nearest-centroid prototype vs exemplar k-NN; real latents vs frozen-random geometry
contract.baseline: exemplar k-NN classifier and a frozen-random projection on the same categories
contract.null_hypothesis: no typicality gradient (latents uniformly distributed within category, an exemplar bag), or a frozen-random projection shows the same cluster geometry so the structure is not V-JEPA-specific

contract.ablation: surprise-boundary Chunking vs uniform-rate vs shuffled-latent; threshold PR sweep
contract.baseline: uniform-rate segmenter (fixed period) and a shuffled-latent control on the same sequence
contract.null_hypothesis: surprise boundaries do not align with true transitions better than a uniform-rate segmenter (pooled clip latents too coarse temporally, taxonomy 5), or the substrate gives no usable surprise signal

contract.ablation: cross-family probe transfer (train i test j) vs within-family; real vs frozen-random
contract.baseline: shuffle-label chance floor and a frozen-random projection arm on the same families
contract.null_hypothesis: off-diagonal transfer is at chance (no shared abstract relation, each family is its own surface code), or transfer is symmetric and content-driven not relation-driven

contract.ablation: adaptive-halting refiner vs single-pass; halting step correlated with item difficulty
contract.baseline: single-pass head at matched average FLOPs (diagnostics.compute)
contract.null_hypothesis: halting step is uncorrelated with difficulty (refiner halts on a content-irrelevant signal), or at matched average compute the adaptive policy ties the single-pass head (iteration was just depth)

contract.ablation: surprise-bounded chunk summaries vs uniform windows vs random boundaries
contract.baseline: uniform-window summaries and a random-boundary chunking control at matched capacity
contract.null_hypothesis: chunked input ties uniform-window input at matched capacity (chunking is a re-binning with no acquisition benefit), or the C4 boundaries are not reliable enough to help

contract.ablation: linear blend of two prototype centroids vs endpoints; real vs frozen-random manifold
contract.baseline: interpolation in a frozen-random projection and the real-latent nearest-neighbour scale
contract.null_hypothesis: midpoint blends are off-manifold and undecodable (the latent space is not convex for concepts, blends are nonsense), or frozen-random shows identical interpolation behavior

contract.ablation: held-out fraction sweep on the factor grid; real latents vs frozen-random
contract.baseline: frozen-random projection arm swept identically; shuffle-label chance floor
contract.null_hypothesis: accuracy cliffs immediately once any combination is held out (pure conjunction memorization, no systematicity), or the curve is identical to frozen-random (substrate does not buy systematicity)

contract.ablation: mutual-exclusivity-gated 1-shot binding vs nearest-centroid; retention vs vanilla softmax
contract.baseline: K-example nearest-centroid readout (no developmental prior); softmax under interference
contract.null_hypothesis: 1-shot mutual-exclusivity-gated binding ties the nearest-centroid baseline on 1-shot accuracy and is no more interference-robust than a vanilla softmax head

contract.ablation: probe-gate occluded-present factor; memoryless vs WorkingMemory-slot predictor; VoE error gap
contract.baseline: memoryless forward predictor; frozen-random substrate arm; shuffled-frame control
contract.null_hypothesis: the occluded-object-present factor is not linearly decodable from pooled latents (the gate fails), OR illegal-vanish prediction error equals legal-continue error

contract.ablation: observational+interventional vs observational-only at matched capacity on held-out configs
contract.baseline: observational-only capacity-matched predictor; confound-only baseline; shuffled-intervention
contract.null_hypothesis: interventional training does not beat observational-only on held-out cause attribution (the shell learns the observational map and confound, not the causal one)

contract.ablation: exception-item accuracy over time; dip vs added width; dip vs Hopfield exception memory
contract.baseline: monotone-baseline expectation; capacity sweep (width guard); exception-memory ablation
contract.null_hypothesis: exception-item accuracy is monotone (no over-regularization dip), or any dip is just capacity starvation removed by width alone

contract.ablation: LP-selection vs random vs reverse ordering over the family pool; noisy-TV guard
contract.baseline: random ordering, reverse ordering, point-error curiosity (noisy-TV trap)
contract.null_hypothesis: LP-ordering ties random ordering on final accuracy AND LP entry order is uncorrelated with measured family difficulty

contract.ablation: position of a target concept block (early vs late), plus a matched-total-data check
contract.baseline: the same content in the reverse (late) position at matched total data and matched compute
contract.null_hypothesis: there is no sensitive window: the SAME evidence presented early vs late in training produces the same final competence at matched total data, so exposure order does not shape the shell the way a developmental critical period shapes a child

contract.ablation: teacher frontier-gating via ContextGating vs unscaffolded vs self-LP-only vs random-mask
contract.baseline: unscaffolded baseline; self-LP-only; random-mask control (gating with no frontier info)
contract.null_hypothesis: scaffolding ties self-curriculum and unscaffolded training (external frontier gating adds no measured benefit over self-generated learning progress)

contract.ablation: demonstration-conditioned (concat) rollout vs unconditioned predictor on held-out starts
contract.baseline: unconditioned predictor; shuffled-demonstration control; context-free baseline
contract.null_hypothesis: demonstration conditioning gives no rollout improvement on novel starts (a simpler unconditioned control ties it), or true imitation needs real action (taxonomy 7)

contract.ablation: probe-gate relation decodability; relation classifier transfer to held-out pairs vs surface
contract.baseline: surface-feature baseline; frozen-random substrate arm; shuffled-relation control
contract.null_hypothesis: the relation factor is not decodable from pooled latents (taxonomy 3), or there is no transfer beyond surface features

contract.ablation: predictor capacity x task separation; arms = {naive, replay+EWC}
contract.baseline: ordinary sequential training (no replay, no EWC, fixed LR)
contract.null_hypothesis: with shuffled task labels (or matched capacity/difficulty) naive and protected show no retention gap; if no forgetting, tasks too easy; if no learning, target not decodable from the frozen latent

contract.ablation: replay scheme = {none, random, prioritized, replay+EWC} at matched buffer size
contract.baseline: no-replay sequential training over a domain-incremental latent stream
contract.null_hypothesis: prioritized replay ties random replay AND replay ties no-replay (stream too short or latents not distinct enough for buffer content to matter)

contract.ablation: plasticity schedule arms = {constant, soft decay, hard staged, staged+triggered}
contract.baseline: constant LR (no plasticity controller, fixed base_lr)
contract.null_hypothesis: staged plasticity is just an LR trick: the hard critical-period schedule ties BOTH constant LR and a tuned soft decay on the adaptation-retention frontier, and on a frozen substrate there is no sensitivity window (no Fisher rise-then-fall) to shape

contract.ablation: gate in {ungated, point-error, ensemble-disagreement} on noisy-TV (learnable + noise regions)
contract.baseline: ungated learning (constant attention on learnable and noise alike)
contract.null_hypothesis: point prediction-error gating allocates as much attention to the noisy-TV region as ungated (conflates epistemic with aleatoric) while ensemble-disagreement gating does not

contract.ablation: selection policy: random vs prediction-error curiosity vs learning-progress curiosity
contract.baseline: random/uniform data selection over the fixed learnable+noise pool

contract.null_hypothesis: the closed-loop homeostat ties the best tuned open-loop schedule on frontier AUC (feedback adds machinery, the metric does not move), OR the loop is unstable and underperforms; on the noisy-TV it chases aleatoric error

contract.ablation: EFE decomposed into epistemic vs complexity vs pragmatic; each scored on noisy-TV budget
contract.baseline: the EX8 learning-progress signal on the learnable-vs-noise budget (the same engine)
contract.null_hypothesis: the free-energy selector does not beat learning-progress on coverage or noisy-TV rejection, and the epistemic term is rank-correlated with learning-progress near 1 (free energy is learning-progress relabeled)

contract.ablation: linear z' = A z + B a system identification vs action-shuffle; controllability Gramian
contract.baseline: action-shuffled linear fit (B should collapse) and the marginal next-latent floor
contract.null_hypothesis: actions do not linearly move the pooled latent state (B indistinguishable from the action-shuffle control, controllability Gramian rank-deficient), so the pooled latent is not a controllable state and EX2 planning is not licensed

contract.ablation: leaky recurrent state h over the ordered stream vs stateless; state-norm + effective rank
contract.baseline: stateless head reading z_t alone at matched compute (diagnostics.compute FLOPs)
contract.null_hypothesis: the recurrent state either diverges/saturates (no useful bounded dynamics) or, when stable, provides no forward-transfer gain over the stateless head at matched compute (the stream is too uniform to carry usable state)

contract.ablation: verify-revise loop vs plain refinement vs shuffled-verifier control; Lyapunov V descent
contract.baseline: plain EX17 refinement and a compute-matched single-shot head at equal FLOPs
contract.null_hypothesis: V does not decrease monotonically (the verifier carries no usable correction direction, the shuffled-verifier control ties it) OR verify-revise ties plain EX17 and the compute-matched single-shot head (self-correction was just more depth)

limits: Capability packs are analyst-defined overlapping tags.
Distinct implementation families do not establish independent generators, context-disjoint niches, causal reuse, or nonlinear cooperation.
